terra.problem: The text says Jesus asks to be shown a denarius, not that He takes the coin or that it belongs to the spies.
The text does not say their belief is the reason for everything they ask next.
The text does not say the Sadducees tell the story to try to stump Jesus.
Saying the Sadducees are trying to make it a puzzle assigns them an intention the text does not give.
Calling Abraham, Isaac and Jacob Israel's forefathers adds a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
Calling Abraham, Isaac and Jacob Israel's forefathers adds a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The text does not say the Sadducees came with tricks or had nothing left to ask. It says they did not dare to question Jesus further.
